SpamTag
  Defines a score or action assigned to a spam classification tag.

  Variants:
    Score: Assign Score
      Fields:
        score  number<float>  mutable
            The score for the tag
        tag    string<string>  mutable
            The spam tag name
    Discard: Discard
      Fields:
        tag  string<string>  mutable
            The spam tag name
    Reject: Reject
      Fields:
        tag  string<string>  mutable
            The spam tag name

Filters:
    tag  text  Tag name
